headline: Jai Prakash Agarwal triggers SEBI Takeover disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Jai Prakash Agarwal has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, Regulation 31(4), signalling a crossing of acquisition thresholds in Surya Roshni Limited.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to NSE in accordance with Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, which mandates notification to the stock exchange when an acquirer crosses or commits to cross specified thresholds (typically 25%, 50%, or higher). This filing is a mandatory first step in the takeover process, requiring the acquirer to provide detailed information on the acquisition strategy, funding, and any material effects on employees, creditors, and security holders. The submission triggers a 4-working-day window for the target company to seek shareholders' approval and for the acquirer to announce the open offer terms (if 25% threshold is breached).
